turns.text: Get the calls I have at 6.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls at 6.
I mean: pick the first of them.

turns.text: Please find out who that call is with.
turns.rephrase: I mean: see who it is with.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE person_on_call_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: person_on_call_at

turns.rephrase: I mean: find all calls with Dad.

turns.text: Work out how many there are and give it back.
turns.rephrase: I mean: count them, then return the count.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_with

turns.text: With person_on_call_at, work out who I call at 6.
turns.rephrase: I mean: use person_on_call_at to find who is on the 6 call.

turns.text: Please use count_calls_with on that person and then give it back.
turns.rephrase: I mean: count the calls with that person using count_calls_with and then return the count.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_for_time_person(time:TIME)
$v0 = CALL person_on_call_at time={time}
$v1 = CALL count_calls_with person=$v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_for_time_person

turns.text: REQUEST count calls with whoever is on the dusk call
